from harness import *

def one(wire, peer='edge', auth='alice', egress='internal', t=0, wire_hex=None):
    out = run(envelope([ev(t, peer=peer, auth=auth, egress=egress, wire=wire, wire_hex=wire_hex)]))
    r = out['results'][0]
    return r['reason'] if r['decision'] == 'reject' else ('OK:' + r['decision'])

cases = []
def C(desc, wire, expected, **kw):
    cases.append((desc, wire, expected, kw))

# ---- stage 1: hex
C('odd hex', None, 'hex', wire_hex='abc')
C('non-hex chars', None, 'hex', wire_hex='zz' + '00')
C('space in hex', None, 'hex', wire_hex='4d 45')
C('unicode hex', None, 'hex', wire_hex='\u00e9' * 2)
C('empty hex', '', 'syntax', wire_hex='')

# ---- stage 2: syntax
w = req()
C('no delimiter', b'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nFrom: x', 'syntax')
C('bare LF endings', b'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\nFrom: a\n\n', 'syntax')
C('bare CR in header', req(extra=['X: a\rb']), 'syntax')
C('DEL byte', b'MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0\r\nX: a\x7fb\r\nFrom: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t\r\nTo: <sip:bob@lab.test>\r\nCall-ID: c\r\nCSeq: 1 MESSAGE\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n', 'syntax')
C('non-ascii header byte', req(extra=['X: \u00e9'.encode('latin-1').decode('latin-1')]), 'syntax')
C('bad method', req(startline='OPTIONS sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'), 'syntax')
C('lowercase method', req(startline='message sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'), 'syntax')
C('bad version', req(startline='MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.1'), 'syntax')
C('double space', req(startline='MESSAGE  sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'), 'syntax')
C('tab separator', req(startline='MESSAGE\tsip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'), 'syntax')
C('tel target', req(target='tel:+12025550100'), 'syntax')
C('bad target uri', req(target='sip:bob@localhost'), 'syntax')
C('leading space startline', req(startline=' MESSAGE sip:bob@lab.test SIP/2.0'), 'syntax')
C('continuation after startline', req(extra=['  folded']), 'syntax')
C('no colon', req(extra=['X-Note oops']), 'syntax')
C('empty header name', req(extra=[': v']), 'syntax')
C('space in name', req(extra=['X Note: v']), 'syntax')
C('bad name char', req(extra=['X@Note: v']), 'syntax')
C('too many lines', req(extra=['X%d: v' % i for i in range(257)]), 'syntax')
C('256 extra lines ok', req(extra=['X%d: v' % i for i in range(256)]), 'OK:accept')
C('line too long', req(extra=['X: ' + 'a' * 8190]), 'syntax')
C('line exactly 8192', req(extra=['X: ' + 'a' * 8189]), 'OK:accept')
C('header block too big', req(extra=['X%d: %s' % (i, 'a' * 200) for i in range(200)]), 'syntax')
C('request too big', req(body=b'a' * 65400, extra=['X: y']), 'syntax')
C('folded value ok', req(extra=['X: a', ' b']), 'OK:accept')

# ---- stage 3: headers
C('missing from', req(headers=['To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'headers')
C('missing cseq', req(headers=['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'headers')
C('dup from', req(extra=['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t2']), 'headers')
C('dup compact from', req(extra=['f: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t2']), 'headers')
C('compact ok', req(headers=['f: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t', 't: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'i: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'l: 0']), 'OK:accept')
C('dup content-length compact', req(extra=['l: 0']), 'headers')

# ---- stage 4: length
C('cl mismatch', req(cl='5', body=b'abc'), 'length')
C('cl extra body', req(cl='2', body=b'abc'), 'length')
C('cl non digit', req(headers=['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: x']), 'length')
C('cl 11 digits', req(cl='00000000000', body=b''), 'length')
C('cl leading zeros ok', req(cl='003', body=b'abc'), 'OK:accept')
C('cl empty', req(cl=''), 'length')
C('cl beats fields', req(cl='9', body=b'abc', from_='badfrom'), 'length')

# ---- stage 5: fields
C('from no tag', req(from_='sip:alice@lab.test'), 'fields')
C('from two tags', req(extra=[]) if False else req(headers=['From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=a;tag=b', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'fields')
C('from other param', req(headers=['From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=a;foo=b', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'fields')
C('from tag empty', req(headers=['From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'fields')
C('from tag 33', req(headers=['From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=' + 'a' * 33, 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'fields')
C('from tag 32 ok', req(headers=['From: <sip:alice@lab.test>;tag=' + 'a' * 32, 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'OK:accept')
C('from TAG case', req(headers=['From: sip:alice@lab.test ; TAG = t1', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1 MESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'OK:accept')
C('to mismatch', req(to='<sip:carol@lab.test>'), 'fields')
C('to param', req(to='<sip:bob@lab.test>;tag=x'), 'fields')
C('to tel', req(to='<tel:+12025550200>'), 'fields')
C('callid bad char', req(call_id='a+b'), 'fields')
C('callid 65', req(call_id='a' * 65), 'fields')
C('callid empty', req(call_id=''), 'fields')
C('cseq zero', req(cseq='0'), 'fields')
C('cseq 11 digits', req(cseq='00000000001'), 'fields')
C('cseq method mismatch', req(cseq='1 INVITE'), 'fields')
C('cseq no space', req(cseq='1MESSAGE'), 'fields')
C('cseq tab ok', req(headers=['From: sip:alice@lab.test;tag=t', 'To: <sip:bob@lab.test>', 'Call-ID: c', 'CSeq: 1\tMESSAGE', 'Content-Length: 0']), 'OK:accept')
C('cseq big ok', req(cseq='2147483647'), 'OK:accept')
C('cseq too big', req(cseq='2147483648'), 'fields')
C('cseq 0000000001 ok', req(cseq='0000000001'), 'OK:accept')

# PAI/PPI
C('pai empty row', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity:']), 'fields')
C('pai empty item', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>,']), 'fields')
C('pai three items', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550100>, <sip:desk@lab.test>']), 'fields')
C('pai two sip', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <sip:desk@lab.test>']), 'fields')
C('pai sip+sips', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <sips:alice@lab.test>']), 'fields')
C('pai identical', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <sip:alice@lab.test>']), 'fields')
C('pai two rows', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>']), 'fields')
C('pai sip+tel ok (access discard)', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>, <sip:alice@lab.test>']), 'OK:accept')
C('ppi unknown alias', req(extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:evil@lab.test>']), 'identity')
C('ppi other account', req(extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:bob@lab.test>']), 'identity')
C('ppi quoted comma', req(extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: "A, B" <sip:desk@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550100>']), 'OK:accept')
C('privacy bad token', req(extra=['Privacy: header']), 'fields')
C('privacy empty', req(extra=['Privacy:']), 'fields')
C('privacy mixed', req(extra=['Privacy: id;none']), 'fields')
C('privacy empty item', req(extra=['Privacy: id;']), 'fields')
C('privacy two rows mixed', req(extra=['Privacy: id', 'Privacy: none']), 'fields')
C('privacy repeat ok', req(extra=['Privacy: ID ; id']), 'OK:accept')

# ---- stage 6/7
C('access unauth', req(), 'auth', auth=None)
C('relay no pai', req(), 'identity', peer='trunk', auth=None)
C('relay with ppi', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>', 'P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>']), 'identity', peer='trunk', auth=None)
C('relay ok', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>']), 'OK:accept', peer='trunk', auth=None)
C('relay unknown alias', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:nobody@lab.test>']), 'identity', peer='trunk', auth=None)
C('relay two accounts', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550200>']), 'identity', peer='trunk', auth=None)
C('from anon no privacy', req(from_='sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid'), 'identity')

C('from other alias', req(from_='sip:desk@lab.test'), 'OK:accept')
C('from tel alias', req(from_='tel:+12025550100'), 'OK:accept')
C('from unregistered', req(from_='sip:mallory@lab.test'), 'identity')

fails = 0
for desc, wire, expected, kw in cases:
    got = one(wire, **kw)
    if got != expected:
        fails += 1
        print('FAIL %-32s expected %-12s got %s' % (desc, expected, got))
print('cases:', len(cases), 'fails:', fails)
